images.caption: Southern cliffs of the Magaliesberg, near Skeerpoort, South Africa. Even during this dry summer, water was seeping from the rock cracks, sustaining animals and vegetation. Numerous cremnophytes are visible, with their roots lodged in vertical rock crevices. The northward tilt in the ancient rock strata, a feature of the whole range, is very evident. These sedimentary strata are some 2.3 billion years old, and were tilted by igneous activity some 2.06 to 2.05 billion years ago.
images.alt: Southern cliffs of the Magaliesberg, near Skeerpoort, South Africa. Even during this dry summer, water was seeping from the rock cracks, sustaining animals and vegetation. images.caption: Sundown at Thaba Manzi Ranch, Magaliesburg, South Africa and the chill of the oncoming night was palpable. Our Autumn is in full swing. Summer is on its way back up north - Enjoy it my friends.
images.alt: Sundown at Thaba Manzi Ranch, Magaliesburg, South Africa and the chill of the oncoming night was palpable. Our Autumn is in full swing. Summer is on its way back up north - Enjoy it my friends.

images.caption: There is no doubt that Nature has a way of opening ones eyes and helping to completely relax you in every way, almost rejuvenating you, wait, it does! Truth be told, there is a rather spiritual connotation to being in a place of immense beauty, such as this, especially when you’re outdoors. That rejuvenating feeling I mentioned earlier is probably as a result of the immense amount of natural energy in this area of the country.
